sections.h2: Processed food's share of farm exports rose from 13.7% to 20.4% in a decade

chart.title: Processed food now carries a larger share of India's agricultural exports
chart.sub: Processed food's share of total agricultural exports, %.
chart.source: IBEF agri-export compilation, as cited in the article.

sections.means: Processed food's share of agricultural exports rose from 13.7% to 20.4% over the decade, so India now exports more value-added product.

sections.h2: PMKSY, the cold-chain scheme, gets less than PLISFPI or PMFME in 2026-27

chart.title: PMKSY's ₹915 crore is below both PMFME's ₹1,700 crore and PLISFPI's ₹1,200 crore
chart.sub: Union Budget 2026-27 allocations to the Ministry of Food Processing Industries, ₹ crore.
chart.source: Union Budget 2026-27, as reported in agrijob.in coverage.

sections.means: The 2026-27 allocation puts PMKSY, the one scheme that funds cold chains directly, below both PLISFPI and PMFME.
sections.todo: Compare PMKSY's ₹915 crore with the ₹92,651 crore annual loss before accepting that the budget addresses the gap.

sections.h2: Farm-export earnings fell 9.32% in April–October 2023-24, mostly from a wheat export ban

sections.means: A single restriction, the wheat export ban, drove most of a 9.32% fall, so export earnings depend on domestic food policy.
